metadata_description: Accessibility direction for navigation, forms, motion and responsive layouts.
title: A product that remains usable in real conditions
description: Practicora aims for keyboard access, readable contrast, responsive layouts and motion that respects user preferences.
section_1_description: Interactive controls use visible focus states and predictable tab order.
section_2_description: Dense views reorganize for smaller screens instead of hiding essential actions.
section_3_description: Reduced-motion preferences limit decorative movement while preserving useful state changes.
section_4_description: Accessibility is treated as ongoing product work and should be tested with real users and assistive technologies.
